method: execute exact extracted functions with explicit host-boundary stubs; no CLI, agent model, authentication or cloud session

observations.invariant: pipeline has no barrier between stages; callbacks receive previous, original, index

parallel waits for every thunk, preserves order, turns failures into null, and rejects promise inputs
